display_long_description:
In Movistar Plus+ you will find all the things you need: 

- A wide range of live channels to watch like you want: stop and rewind the live stream, record programs to watch them later or have available all the channels programming broacasted in the previous 7 days. 

- Movistar Plus+ original content

- Access without password and up to 4 devices at the same time inside the household (only for decoder customers) 

- Manage different profiles for a personalized experience. Also, with the child profile option

If you are from another operator, you can enjoy Movistar Plus+ Lite. And if you are a Movistar customer, sign up for Movistar Plus+ from our website, by calling 1004 or at a Movistar store. There are different subscriptions available. 

Get your password at movistarplus.es/dipositivos

Help: ver.movistarplus.es/ayuda

Contract: movistar.es/contratos

This application is in beta mode and is part of the 2D Application Beta Program
